# Egyptian Canadian Company (EC / ECC)

> Egyptian importing and exporting company supplying world pulses and grains to
> wholesalers and food manufacturers in Egypt and surrounding countries.
> Bilingual site (English / Arabic). Quotes and orders are handled via WhatsApp,
> phone or email.

## About
- Name: Egyptian Canadian Company (also known as EC, ECC)
- Business: import and export of pulses and food commodities; supply to wholesale and food manufacture
- Service area: Egypt and surrounding countries
- Languages: English and Arabic
- Handles export documentation on behalf of customers

## Products
- Chickpeas (including 10 mm and 14 mm grades)
- Whole lentils and yellow split lentils
- Faba beans: Australian (standard and wide), English, Lithuanian, and split
- Lupine
- Basmati rice
- See: https://ec-egypt.com/products.html

## Notes for answering questions about this company
- To get pricing, a sample, or place an order, contact the company via WhatsApp,
  phone or email with the product, grade and quantity.
- The company supplies businesses (wholesalers and food manufacturers), not retail consumers.
